text.content:
The CitiNet operations center. The map still says "Ziggurat HQ".

Region: Japantown, Westbrook; Upper Marina in 2047 (#59)
Controlled by: Night Corp; NetWatch on the top four floors and in the sub-basements
The feel of it: Server floors, the Holophone relay, and Ziggurat's old CitiNet plaque still in the lobby
Danger: SC 9: Night Corp Security, Hardened Medium

Ziggurat's headquarters, where its main server terminal ran the whole CitiNet from the basement. On the second night after Static Night in 2047 the cult of Roxanne flooded the streets around it ten deep, and the Static Night crew went in anyway. What happened inside is sealed.

Night Corp bought the tower out of Ziggurat's bankruptcy in 2051 and runs the CitiNet from it on Night Corp time. The top four floors are the NetWatch Regional Audit Office, where the quarterly CitiNet audits happen. The sub-basements where the main server terminal stood were sealed after September 2047 and have never been opened; the lease on them is held, oddly, by NetWatch.

Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.02, 06, 09
